title: Witness & Attestation — Digital Provenance, Derivation and Authenticity
purpose: Give the Witness Room a concrete digital-provenance model for originals, derivatives, edits, screenshots, mirrors, timestamps and authenticity claims.
epistemic_rule: Authenticity of an artifact is not the same as truth of the statement inside it. Provenance can show where an artifact came from, how it changed and whether bindings validate; it cannot by itself verify every proposition depicted or quoted.

w3c_prov_model.entity: A physical, digital, conceptual or other thing whose provenance can be described: post, screenshot, video, transcript, document, dataset.
w3c_prov_model.activity: A process that creates or changes an entity: capture, crop, transcription, translation, edit, repost, compilation.
w3c_prov_model.agent: A person, organization or software system associated with an activity or entity.
w3c_prov_model.project_translation: Represent artifact lineage as entity → activity → derived entity, with agent and timestamp where known.

c2pa_model.provenance: C2PA models the history of an asset and its interaction with actors/assets through manifests and assertions.
c2pa_model.authenticity: C2PA treats authenticity as cryptographically verifiable facts such as provenance data and bindings that have not been tampered with.
c2pa_model.critical_boundary: The C2PA specification explicitly avoids judging whether provenance data is 'good' or 'bad'; validation of an assertion's association/integrity is not a truth verdict on the content.
c2pa_model.project_translation: When Content Credentials exist, preserve them as high-value provenance signals. When absent, do not infer falsity; use ordinary source-chain methods.

artifact_classes.definition: Original first-party asset with platform/file metadata and stable identifier where available.
Screenshot/export/capture that preserves the source artifact with enough metadata/context to identify it.
Repost, mirror, quote-card, clip, transcription or conversion derived from another artifact.
artifact_classes.rule: Counts as another distribution artifact, not automatically another independent witness.

artifact_classes.definition: Artifact materially altered through crop, splice, annotation, translation, enhancement or montage.
artifact_classes.rule: Store the edit activity and preserve the upstream source if known.

artifact_classes.definition: Later attempt to recreate wording/order from fragments, memory or multiple derivatives.
artifact_classes.rule: Never label reconstruction as exact quotation or original artifact.

minimum_attestation_packet: artifact identifier or best available locator
exact timestamp plus timezone/precision where known
capture time separately from publication time
context envelope: thread, surrounding turns, title, description or scene
hash or integrity signal where available
derivation_rules: A screenshot of a post is evidence about what the screenshot displays; if the original post is gone, note that the screenshot is the surviving artifact.
A quote inside another person's post is secondary unless independently linked to the original.
Ten mirrors descending from one upload remain one source lineage plus ten distribution events.
A transcript produced from audio is a derived text artifact; preserve the audio/timecode owner when exact wording matters.
Translation is an activity that creates a new linguistic entity; preserve source-language wording for disputed terms.
Capture timestamp and event/publication timestamp must not be silently treated as identical.
Deletion of the original raises preservation risk but does not automatically invalidate a previously well-provenanced capture.

authenticity_vs_truth.authenticity_question: Is this artifact what its provenance claims it is, and has it been altered?
authenticity_vs_truth.attestation_question: What wording/action does this artifact actually show, by whom and when?
authenticity_vs_truth.truth_question: Is the proposition inside the artifact factually correct?
authenticity_vs_truth.rule: These are three different questions and can receive three different answers.
